If the problem instead asks about a contiguous range whose complete contents determine validity, the same sorted input may be irrelevant or may merely simplify the range predicate. The transfer rule is to connect sortedness to a concrete proof, not to a memorized association.

blocks.text: Sortedness simplifies the range statistic: the endpoints give the minimum and maximum. It does not change candidate membership. Every element between left and right belongs to the run, its length is the objective, and the linear scan reuses the previous left boundary, advancing it only until the endpoint difference is valid. This is a window invariant. A separate method could binary-search the earliest valid left for each right in O(n log n), but that is not the described scan. If the task selected any two values and ignored the interior, sortedness could instead support a pair relation.

The boundary is semantic preservation, not merely time complexity.
